text: dsh-client-ui-trace-graph 在 DSH Web 对话页增加「轨迹图谱」标签，从官方轨迹快照生成可交互的 DAG。图中区分时间顺序与有数据依据的结构关系，展示消息、模型和工具记录，并支持悬停查看上下游、点击查看输入输出 JSON。可切换 Dagre 层级与 d3-force 布局，也提供启用、代理提示和默认布局设置，适合可视化检查 DSH 会话执行过程。

dsh-client-ui-trace-graph adds a DSH Web conversation tab that turns the official trajectory snapshot into an interactive DAG. It shows sequence and structure links, highlights neighbors on hover, and opens node input/output JSON. Choose Dagre or d3-force layout.
想把 DSH 会话里的执行轨迹画成流程图。

让 DSH 的轨迹视图能展示节点之间的因果结构。
怎么点击某条轨迹记录查看它的输入和输出？
希望切换会话执行图的布局方式。
Show me an interactive graph of a DSH conversation trace.
I want to inspect model and tool execution order visually.
dsh-client-ui-trace-graph 的功能「轨迹关系图」：把会话轨迹投影为节点和连线，区分相邻记录的执行顺序与有字段依据的结构关系；打开对话页的「轨迹图谱」标签查看。
dsh-client-ui-trace-graph 的功能「布局切换」：在图谱工具栏切换 Dagre 层级布局或 d3-force 力导向布局，以不同方式浏览同一组轨迹节点。
dsh-client-ui-trace-graph 的功能「查看轨迹详情」：点击图中的节点可查看记录的输入和输出 JSON，悬停时高亮相关的上下游节点。

Turn the official DSH Web GUI **trajectory** ledger into an interactive DAG: the same live records as the built-in「轨迹」tab, rendered as a ReactFlow graph so you can see execution order and proven structure at a glance.
@tieveto666-code/dsh-client-ui-trace-graph README · Why this plugin：Official「轨迹」is a powerful inspection table. This plugin keeps that **same source of truth** and adds a spatial reading of the run:

@tieveto666-code/dsh-client-ui-trace-graph README · Why this plugin：- **Same data, no second ledger** — reads `snapshot.views.get('trajectory')` (plus safe fallbacks). What you see in the graph is what the session already recorded, not a mock or a parallel log.
- **Two edge kinds you can trust** — gray sequence edges always show *what happened next*; colored structure edges appear only when row fields prove a causal / nesting link. No invented arrows.
- **Debug the agent loop visually** — SYSTEM / USER / CONTEXT / ASSISTANT / TOOL / SUBTOOL / COMPACTION as typed nodes, with summary, sequence #, latency, status, and token usage; click a node for Input / Output JSON.
- **Fits the official shell** — mounts as a first-party conversation view tab (not a modal or center-column takeover); chrome colors follow `--dsw-*` themes and skins.
- **Layouts for different questions** — dagre hierarchy (default) for causal depth; d3-force for an organic overview; switch anytime from the toolbar.

@tieveto666-code/dsh-client-ui-trace-graph README · How to read the graph：| Visual | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **Gray dashed edge (`sequence`)** | Chronological **execution order**. Always drawn between adjacent trajectory records: A happened, then B. Legend: 「执行顺序 / Sequence」. |
| **Colored solid edge (`structure`)** | Proven **structure / causality** (semantic color by target label). Emitted only when fields prove a link — e.g. prompt/context → next assistant, assistant → tool call, tool/subtool nesting, tool result consumed by a later assistant. Legend: 「结构关系 / Structure」. |
| **Node label** | Real trajectory label (`SYSTEM`, `USER`, `CONTEXT`, `ASSISTANT`, `TOOL`, …). |
| **Node body** | Real summary, sequence number, latency, status, token usage. |
| **Detail panel** | Click a node to inspect recorded Input / Output JSON. |

@tieveto666-code/dsh-client-ui-trace-graph README · How to read the graph：**Reading tip:** gray only = order is known, stronger relationship is not proven; gray + color = order plus a verified upstream/downstream link.

@tieveto666-code/dsh-client-ui-trace-graph README · Features：- Conversation tab 「轨迹图谱 / Trace Graph」 beside official views.
- Hover highlighting of upstream / downstream neighbors.
- Toolbar layout toggle: dagre / d3-force; ResizeObserver re-fits when the view or sidebar resizes.
- Settings card (Settings → Plugins): `enabled`, `announceToAgent`, `defaultLayout`.
- Optional host announcement so agents know the plugin is installed.

@tieveto666-code/dsh-client-ui-trace-graph README · Data model：The browser adapter projects each live trajectory row into a `TraceSpan`, preserving label, summary, source seq, turn, step, status, timing, and Input/Output references. Every pair of adjacent records gets a `sequence` edge; `structure` edges are added only for relationships proven by row fields (see [How to read the graph](#how-to-read-the-graph)).
